pictures.author: Giorgi gugberidze
pictures.observations: Whole960x640: pale pink/cream long-format brick cross-domed church, tall blind-arcaded drum with slit windows and small turquoise glazed accents, weathered gray conical slab roof/cross, intersecting nave/transept gables and low side roofs. Pale stone porch has an actual large front arch and twin side arches. Copied photo camera geotag conflicts with mapped gateway relationship; do not use it as facing control.

pictures.author: ILIA
pictures.observations: Whole500x889: church behind a separate rectangular brick pointed-arch gateway. Flat stepped brick top/nested arch frames, wood leaves/recessed center, low rough stone enclosure beside it. No roofed belfry or upper triple arcade. Mapped gate is south of church; copied camera geotag is inconsistent and ignored.

pictures.author: Kober
pictures.observations: Whole960x720 close porch side resolves two real round arches/central carved pier, pale ashlar, molded cornice and weathered gray slab seams. Main wooden door behind open porch. Original simple leaf/scroll bands rather than copied carving pixels. Temporary scaffolding omitted.

pictures.author: Jonathan Cardy
pictures.observations: Whole960x638 southwest exterior confirms lower aisle roofs below intersecting high gables, tall drum/round blind arches/slits, gray slab cone/cross and front plus twin side porch openings. Small temporary bell shelter/landscaping remain context. Eastern/rear fine details are not resolved by these pictures and remain simplified map-led masonry, not a claimed survey.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Standing Timotesubani Dormition church and separate mapped brick gateway: cream/pink thin-course brick cross-domed body, stepped nave/transept/aisle gables, tall slit-window blind-arcaded drum with original turquoise geometric accents and gray slab cone/cross. Pale stone gabled porch has a true front passage and twin open side arches, simple original carved pier/rim forms. Separate gateway uses nested pointed brick arch and recessed wood leaves. St Barbara chapel, shop, monastic cells, temporary bell shelter/scaffolding, enclosure beyond gateway and landscaping remain independent host context. No copied frescoes, inscription/sculpture atlas or hidden furnished interior.
